race.comment: PHOTOSYNTHESIS (8) is building nicely this prep, having gone under by a length and a half at this track after being held up approaching the 250m, and her previous Bunbury fourth was only a head from the winner. Third-up, she has the right platform to break through. SNIPPETS RETURN (9) has been fifth in two runs back, the latest on soft ground at Kalgoorlie, and his effort at Belmont two back gives him a solid reference for this. NON REFLECTIVE (10) resumes from Saturday company, trialled third at Belmont and was considered good enough to start favourite before spelling, so he has clear upside despite being unplaced so far. OUR MANE MAN (7) can make his presence felt.
